About the Lumlum processing table.

Every item at the Lumlum stage carries a grade, and every grade has an unit.

The processing list.

If an item has grade nakpyr, its unit is tutu.
If an item has grade zelxil, its unit is zamyuk.
If an item has grade nakka, its unit is xilzam.
If an item has grade drimi, its unit is yukka.

When a grade is not on the list, the unit is fexdri.

The processing list.

If an item has grade driyuk, its unit is lumtu.
If an item has grade nakzel, its unit is zelka.
If an item has grade xilnak, its unit is vortez.
If an item has grade cloyuk, its unit is pyrlum.

When a grade is not on the list, the unit is cloyuk.
